articles.headline: Royal flush? Brazil great Neymar wins $24,000 in poker game
articles.description: Neymar has bagged $24,000 at the poker table in Brazil.

articles.headline: Chapecoense plane crash survivor wins promotion in final match
articles.description: Alan Ruschel, a survivor of the 2016 plane crash that was carrying the Chapecoense team, retired from football on a high note after helping his boyhood club Juventude win promotion to Brazil's Serie A in the final game of the season.

articles.headline: Neymar gets 2-match ban for covering mouth while confronting opponent
articles.description: Neymar was suspended for two matches on Wednesday for covering his mouth while arguing with an opponent during a Brazilian league game.

articles.headline: Bahia condemn Neymar for 'verbal abuse' after red card
articles.description: Brazilian club Bahia have condemned the alleged "verbal abuse" directed at their player Rodrigo Nestor by Santos star Neymar during Saturday's league game.

articles.headline: Neymar fury after he's sent off under 'Vinícius Júnior rule'
articles.description: Neymar was left furious after he was sent off under the 'Vinícius Júnior rule' on Saturday night.

articles.headline: Corinthians hire Clarence Seedorf as head coach after seven consecutive league defeats
articles.description: Corinthians hired Clarence Seedorf on Sunday for the Netherlands playing great's first coaching job since 2019 -- and a relegation fight in Brazil's top tier.
